topic: sub:12|Relative frequency and probability|Probability from 0 to 1

parts.latex:
Ashley checks the weather app on her phone and sees that:

“It will likely rain this afternoon.”

Which of the following best represents the probability of an event that will “likely occur”?

solutions.latex:
"Likely" means a probability above $50\%$ but not certain, so $75\%$ fits best.

Hence the answer is option C.
